W1.name: language_implication_pragmatics
W1.qsre_role: consume multi-layer token semantics and preserve fine-grained query language needed for relational/operator interpretation
W1.outside_qsre: general pragmatic understanding remains semantic/N0 capability; QSRE is not the whole language model

W2.name: evidence_provenance_epistemic_role
W2.qsre_role: binder/executor consume typed provenance reliability confidence and temporal metadata; support is distinct from truth authority
W2.outside_qsre: canonical source authority and provenance governance remain in structured/memory systems
W2.closure_requirement: provenance must remain explicit through support and readout

W3.name: relational_causal_reasoning
W3.qsre_role: primary responsibility: dynamic schema grounding, argument roles, adaptive support, multi-hop execution, structural readout
W3.closure_requirement: dynamic relation schema, learned structural focus, explicit role+direction, and variable-step forward/reverse/bidirectional execution without ID ontology ceiling

W4.name: temporal_state_change
W4.qsre_role: temporal constraints and recency modifiers participate compositionally in operator, binder, executor and readout
W4.outside_qsre: long-lived state trajectories remain structured/memory context
W4.closure_requirement: temporal behavior is not a mutually exclusive single operation class

W5.name: relationship_sensitive_interpretation
W5.qsre_role: support arbitrary typed actor/relationship relations and asymmetric endpoint structure
W5.outside_qsre: private relationship policy and Elaina-derived relationship judgment belong to N1/N2
W5.closure_requirement: schema and context interfaces cannot assume factual-KG-only relations

W6.name: values_tradeoffs
W6.qsre_role: supply inspectable relational/evidence state relevant to later tradeoff judgment
W6.outside_qsre: value weighting and identity tradeoff policy belong to later judgment layers
W6.closure_requirement: QSRE must not collapse N0 into one relational reward scalar

W7.name: candidate_comparison_action_response_ranking
W7.qsre_role: provide evidence/path state for candidate reasoning when relations matter
W7.outside_qsre: setwise candidate ranking is broader N0/N2 capability
W7.closure_requirement: QSRE outputs remain composable and do not assume one final candidate

W8.name: emotional_interpretation_response_posture
W8.qsre_role: may connect typed social/emotional evidence and actors when relational structure matters
W8.outside_qsre: emotional posture policy belongs to semantic/structured N0 and later identity judgment
W8.closure_requirement: relation schema accepts social/context relations without hard factual ontology

W9.name: voice_first_expressive_policy
W9.qsre_role: consume optional typed observations if relationally relevant; emit no waveform
W9.outside_qsre: voice observations and expressive output controls belong to voice/N0/IDP interfaces
W9.closure_requirement: absence of voice data cannot break QSRE

W10.name: uncertainty_plurality
W10.qsre_role: preserve sparse plural operator hypotheses, plural support, uncertain readout and UNKNOWN/defer
W10.outside_qsre: global calibration also belongs to later N0/N3
W10.closure_requirement: no mandatory early argmax or singleton relation commitment; STOP, UNKNOWN, calibrated applicability and control remain distinct through execution

W11.name: generic_assistant_sycophancy_drift
W11.qsre_role: provide evidence/precedent pointers when relationally relevant
W11.outside_qsre: drift detection is identity/judgment capability, not QSRE
W11.closure_requirement: QSRE remains an evidence primitive and never becomes hidden personality policy

W12.name: continuity_self_development
W12.qsre_role: consume versioned typed A-EXP/A-SELF relations/provenance through dynamic schema and metadata
W12.outside_qsre: continuity updating and source-authority semantics remain memory/identity systems
W12.closure_requirement: schema migration supports successor relation vocabularies without replacing weights

W13.name: heterogeneous_context_fusion
W13.qsre_role: produce relational view tokens, summary, uncertainty and structural state for fusion
W13.closure_requirement: QSRE adds grounded semantic and native relational-summary evidence to the ratified fusion path without replacing parent views or adding a second router

W14.name: long_context_sparse_relevance
W14.qsre_role: adaptive exact-zero support and runtime-variable field/edge/schema cardinality
W14.outside_qsre: upstream retrieval/context expansion can supply broader candidate context
W14.closure_requirement: no permanent top-k or fixed field/edge relation count

W15.name: fast_deliberate_paths
W15.qsre_role: shared iterative decoder/executor with runtime compute budget and sparse support allows fast or expanded execution with same weights
W15.closure_requirement: latency defaults cannot become hop/support capability ceilings; runtime path direction and step budget use shared weights
